items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: the band that I was turned on by was Cannonball’s band... I mean Roy McCurdy is a good friend. I love that band too. But all the bands were good, but it was just the way that Cannonball played

ctx.x: Sure. Well you said a magic word just now, Cannonball. Man he was my, and still is, he’s like it. He had everything. He was a wonderful saxophone player, or anybody could — © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

It was a great band. Because the first band I had, my brother and myself, the Harper Brothers. Of course me being the drummer, everybody thought more that we patterned this after Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers. But the band that I was turned on by was Cannonball’s band.
With Roy McCurdy or with Louis Hayes?
